=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "spec" "status"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Compare the spec the current branch records (git config branch.<name>.dashcrew-spec) with the
| knowledge clone: its current rev and status, the ACs this repo's plans claim and the ones none claims.
| Other repos the spec names are listed as not checked. Writes nothing.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew spec status [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml; its branch and plans are read.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --clone      Knowledge clone holding the spec; defaults to the profile's ~/.dashcrew/knowledge/<name>.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
